hero.headline: Welcome to Your New Website
hero.subheadline: A modern, fast, and fully customizable website template built with Astro and powered by Decap CMS.

features.title: Lightning Fast
features.description: Built with Astro for optimal performance. Zero JavaScript by default means your site loads instantly.

features.title: Easy Content Management
features.description: Decap CMS provides a friendly editing interface. Update your content without touching code.
